diagnostics.message: google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service enables the Shared VPC (XPN) feature on the service project (this project, service_project = local.project.project_id), which requires the Compute Engine API to be enabled first. Its host-side sibling (google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.service_projects) reaches google_project_service.project_services transitively via google_compute_shared_vpc_host_project.shared_vpc_host, but the service-side resource has no path to project_services at all, so attaching the service project can race API enablement. Add `depends_on = [google_project_service.project_services]`.

google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_identity_cmek lists google_project.project in depends_on, but its `member` is `${local.service_accounts_robots[...]}` which derives from `local.project.number`, and `local.project.number` is `try(google_project.project.0.number, null)`. That attribute reference already forces ordering after google_project.project, so the explicit depends_on entry is redundant.

google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_identity_cmek lists data.google_project.project in depends_on, but the same `member` expression flows through `local.project.number`, which in the not-create branch is `try(data.google_project.project.0.number, null)`. That attribute reference already establishes the dependency, making the explicit depends_on entry redundant.
